# loading and creating dataset for modeling
The following scripts loads the data set from SE and CN sites and segment the data set into vehicle-vehicle interaction and vehicle-vru interactions. For the CN dataset, we manually assign the interaction ID so that only interaction where all SMoS measurements are available are kept. For each type of the interaction, datasets for running both BM and POT is created.
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
source('preprocessing.R')

# load injury severity models
PIS0 <- function(speed){return(1/(1+exp(5.261 - 0.104*speed))) } # Eq.6 
PIS1 <- function(speed,age){return(1/(1+exp(5.15 - 0.101*speed - 0.042*age))) } # Eq.10 

# MAIS 3+ for VRU Lubbe et al (2022)
PIS2 <- function(speed,age){return(1/(1+exp(6.19 - 0.078*speed - 0.038*age))) } # Table 2, for ped
PIS3 <- function(speed,age){return(1/(1+exp(7.47 - 0.079*speed - 0.047*age))) } # Table 2, for cyclist

injury.df <- data.frame(speed = seq(0,80,0.5)) %>%
  mutate(InjuryP = sapply(speed, PIS0))
```

# assigning the indicators to global variables.
# TTC and Speed_TTC 
```{r,echo=FALSE}
Dat.SE <- SE_TTC
Dat.CN <- CN_TTC_A
x0.1 <- 0
x0.2 <- 0   # crash boundary 
source("scripts/global_vars.R")

Qc(x0.1,Dat.CN$prox,u1)
Qc(x0.2,Dat.SE$prox,u2)
Qc(x0.1,Dat.CN$prox,v.1)
Qc(x0.2,Dat.SE$prox,v.2)
```
# iTTC and Speed_TTC
```{r,echo=FALSE}
Dat.SE <- SE_iTTC
Dat.CN <- CN_iTTC_A
x0.1 <- 1
x0.2 <- 1
source("scripts/global_vars.R")
Qc(x0.1,Dat.CN$prox,u1)
Qc(x0.2,Dat.SE$prox,u2)
Qc(x0.1,Dat.CN$prox,v.1)
Qc(x0.2,Dat.SE$prox,v.2)
```


## BPOT gumbel
```{r,echo=FALSE}

source("scripts/BPOT_logistics.R")

# plots

scale_factor <- max(plot.df.1$ConditionalD)/max(injury.df$InjuryP)

ggplot(plot.df.1,aes(x=speed,y=ConditionalD)) + 
  geom_line(aes(colour = "CN")) + 
  geom_line(data = plot.df.2,aes(x=speed,y=ConditionalD,colour = "SE")) +
  geom_line(data = injury.df,aes(x=speed,y=InjuryP * scale_factor) ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = v1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = v2, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = 12, y = 0.015, 
            label = paste("u=", round(v2,3)), color = "blue") +
  annotate("text", x = 20, y = 0.02, 
            label = paste("u=", round(v1,3)), color = "red")+
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "denisty",  # primary y-axis label
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Injury prob")  # secondary y-axis
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Site", values = c("CN" = "red", "SE" = "blue")) +
  labs(x = "Speed (km/h)", y = "f(y|TTC<0)") +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "gray91"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "gray88"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white",
        colour = "white", linetype = "solid"),
    plot.background = element_rect(linetype = "solid"))
ggsave("plots/impact_speed_density_iTTC_BPOT_gumbel.png")

cat("logistic dependence: thresholds CN:",M.1$threshold,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: parameters SE:",M.2$threshold,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: parameters CN:",M.1$estimate,"\n")
confint(M.1)
cat("logistic dependence: parameters SE:",M.2$estimate,"\n")
confint(M.2)
cat("logistic dependence: Deviance CN:",deviance(M.1),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Deviance SE:",deviance(M.2),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Crash prob CN:",Pcrash.1,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Crash prob SE:",Pcrash.2,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Severe Crash prob CN:",
    pbTvevd(q1=x0.1,q2=40,dep=M.1$estimate[5],thres=c(u1,v1),model="log",
        eta=M.1$nat[1]/M.1$n,
        mar1=c(M.1$estimate[1],M.1$estimate[2]),
        mar2=c(M.1$estimate[3],M.1$estimate[4]),tail.type=2),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Severe Crash prob SE:",
    pbTvevd(q1=x0.2,q2=40,dep=M.2$estimate[5],thres=c(u2,v2),model="log",
        eta=M.2$nat[1]/M.2$n,
        mar1=c(M.2$estimate[1],M.2$estimate[2]),
        mar2=c(M.2$estimate[3],M.2$estimate[4]),tail.type=2),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: INjury prob CN:",
    Injury.from_c_bivariate(plot.df.1,EVmodel=M.1,Pcrash = Pcrash.1,severity = PIS0,x0=x0.1),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: INjury prob SE:",
    Injury.from_c_bivariate(plot.df.2,EVmodel=M.2,Pcrash = Pcrash.2,severity = PIS0,x0=x0.2),"\n")

```

```{r,echo=FALSE}
source("scripts/CBPOT_gumbel.R")

ci(POT.2,type="parameter")
cat("logistic dependence: parameters conseq CN:",Conseq.1$estimate,"\n")
confint(Conseq.1)
cat("logistic dependence: parameters conseq SE:",Conseq.2$estimate,"\n")
confint(Conseq.2)
cat("logistic dependence: copula param CN:","lb",Cop.1@estimate-1.96 * sqrt(Cop.1@var.est),
    "estim",Cop.1@estimate,"ub",Cop.1@estimate+1.96 * sqrt(Cop.1@var.est),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: copula param SE:","lb",Cop.2@estimate-1.96 * sqrt(Cop.2@var.est),
    "estim",Cop.2@estimate,"ub",Cop.2@estimate+1.96 * sqrt(Cop.2@var.est),"\n")

cat("logistic dependence: Deviance CN:",-2*Cop.1@loglik,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Deviance SE:",-2*Cop.2@loglik,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: GoF CN:","test statistics",gof.1$statistic,"p-value",gof.1$p.value,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: GoF SE:","test statistics",gof.2$statistic,"p-value",gof.2$p.value,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Crash prob CN in Q:",Qcrash.1,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Crash prob SE in Q:",Qcrash.2,"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Severe Crash prob CN in Q:",pMvdc(c(x0.1,40),CM0.1),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Severe Crash prob SE:",pMvdc(c(x0.2,40),CM0.2),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Injury prob CN:",
    Injury.from_cQ_bivariate(plot.dfQ.1,CM.1,Qcrash.1,PIS0,x0.1),"\n")
cat("logistic dependence: Injury prob CN:",
    Injury.from_cQ_bivariate(plot.dfQ.2,CM.2,Qcrash.2,PIS0,x0.2),"\n")
```

## Injury severity model
Since the focus is on VRU injury, car-related co-variates such as position of the passenger and seat-belt use are of less interest. Based on the Vision Zero principle that the injury occurs when the energy released in the crash is higher human body tolerence, we decide to include only two covariates in the injury severity model -- age and impact speed. Let $Z, Y$ denote the age and impact speed of VRU respectively at a crash, the injury probability given that a crash between VRU and car occurs is given by: 
$$P(S_i|X\leq 0) = \int P(S_i|Z=z,Y=y\})\mathrm{d}F_Z(z|X\leq 0)\mathrm{d}F_Y(y|X\leq 0)$$

This integral can be written in the form $E_Z\big(E_Y(h(Z,Y))\big)$ can be computed numerically. The rest of the theory section is devoted to the identification of a suitable injury severity model for VRU and the derivation of the conditional density $\mathrm{d}F_Y(y|X\leq 0)$ when the crash is extrapolated by extreme value theory.
